subject: Confidential: appointment of interim team steward for Growth Platform
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Confidential: interim stewardship for Growth Platform - approval requested

Hi Sofia / Marissa —

Hope you both are well. This is a confidential HR request: Marissa has notified us of an upcoming parental leave starting 2027-06-01 for approximately 14 weeks. Per policy, we need a short-term steward named and an approved interim assignment before Marissa goes on leave.

Recommended interim steward: Rohan Mehta (current senior eng lead, noted strong cross-team coordination).

Actions requested:
- Sofia: please confirm that you approve Rohan as the interim manager and that product/roadmap coverage is acceptable.
- Marissa: please attach your handover notes and list of priority projects.
- Neha (People Ops): coordinate compensation uplift and role permissions for the interim period.

I have attached the interim_assignment_form.pdf and manager_transition_checklist.xlsx (sensitive HR doc). This thread should stay restricted to recipients above. Once we have approval, we'll route the form to Finance for one-time budget exception.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior People Partner | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
(Attachment: interim_assignment_form.pdf, manager_transition_checklist.xlsx)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: interim stewardship for Growth Platform - approval requested

Thanks for the heads up, Mina.

High level: I support Rohan as interim steward in principle — he has the context and the trust of the team. Two items I need before formal approval: an explicit list of blockers/offboard tasks (so I can confirm coverage for launch dates) and the expected uplift / budget impact for the backfill.

Can Neha confirm whether the standard interim uplift policy (8-12% stipend for acting managers) applies here or if we need an exception?

I'll block 30 minutes this week to review the handover doc with Marissa and Rohan.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Product, Growth Platform
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
(Attachment referenced: none)

Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: interim stewardship for Growth Platform - approval requested

Sofia / Mina —

Thanks — I agree Rohan is the best steward while I'm on leave. I've attached my handover notes (handover_notes_GrowthPlatform.docx) and a short priorities list. Key points:
- Ship attribution-v2 by 6/20 (Rohan to pair with analytics lead)
- Pause non-critical infra refactor until Q4
- Customer escalations: route to Rohan and escalate to Sofia for critical SLA items

Rohan: please confirm you're comfortable taking on the cross-team PM/eng coordination for the dates 2027-06-01 to 2027-08-31.

Happy to do a handover session next Wednesday — I'll send a calendar invite.

Marissa Cole
Director, Growth Product
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(Attachment: handover_notes_GrowthPlatform.docx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: interim stewardship for Growth Platform - approval requested

Looping in finance next — preliminary guidance: standard interim stipend (8%) will apply automatically under People Ops policy. If we need a higher uplift or a backfill headcount, we will require approval from Finance for a one-time budget exception.

Next steps I will take:
- Submit interim_assignment_form to Finance and include estimated delta (stipend + expected OTE impact if we hire contractor backfill).
- Start permission changes for Rohan (manager-level access: OKRs, payroll view limited).

Mina — please confirm whether we should route this to procurement for an external recruiter involvement (talent@pulse-recruiting.com) in parallel in case a longer-term hire is required after leave.

Neha Kapoor
People Operations
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: interim stewardship for Growth Platform - approval requested

Approved. I reviewed the handover doc and priorities; Rohan has the bandwidth and we've confirmed no customer commitments are at risk. Finance: please proceed with the standard interim stipend. If Neha needs a deviation beyond 10%, escalate back to me.

Routing: Mina — please route the interim_assignment_form through DocuSign and copy me on the final sign-off (link below). Also ensure the handover session invite is recorded in the team calendar and that the customer-facing escalation path is updated.

-Vivek
